label: Ko Samui
short_description: The busy Chaweng coast to the quieter Lamai, Mae Nam and western shores.
intro: Ko Samui's hotels in this directory are all beach resorts spread around the Gulf island's coast: the Chaweng and Chaweng Noi strip on the east side -- the island's busiest beach and nightlife hub -- plus Lamai to the southeast and the quieter Mae Nam and western coves. The portfolio skews luxury, with private-pool villas, destination spas and fine dining the norm rather than the exception. The island is reached via Samui International Airport (USM) in the northeast, a short drive from the Chaweng resorts.
